story: A little fox named Ruby lived in a magical forest...

scenes.narration: A little fox named Ruby lived in a magical forest. Every morning, she would wake up to the sound of singing birds and the smell of wildflowers.
scenes.image_prompt: A cute little red fox waking up in a colorful magical forest, morning sunlight streaming through trees, wildflowers everywhere, butterflies, cartoon style, vibrant colors, clean lines, Disney-Pixar inspired, detailed background, cinematic lighting

scenes.narration: One day, Ruby discovered a glowing crystal hidden beneath an ancient oak tree. It pulsed with a warm golden light that made her heart race with excitement.
scenes.image_prompt: A red fox discovering a glowing golden crystal under a massive ancient oak tree, magical sparkles, forest clearing, warm golden light illuminating the scene, cartoon style, vibrant colors, clean lines, Disney-Pixar inspired, detailed background, cinematic lighting

scenes.narration: But a dark shadow fell over the forest. The evil raven Mordecai had sensed the crystal's power and was coming to steal it.

scenes.narration: Ruby gathered all her courage. She held the crystal high and its light burst forth, banishing the darkness and sending Mordecai fleeing into the night.
scenes.image_prompt: A brave red fox standing tall on a hill, holding up a blazing golden crystal, powerful beams of light shooting outward, dark raven fleeing in the background, epic heroic moment, cartoon style, vibrant colors, clean lines, Disney-Pixar inspired, detailed background, cinematic lighting

scenes.narration: The forest was saved. From that day on, Ruby became known as the Guardian of the Crystal, and peace returned to the magical forest forever.
